title: Reject the first plausible cause: the bug is not where the report points
goal: Since release 0.9.4, which updated the Unicode width table, wrapped CJK text sometimes overflows the requested width (the test `wide_text_respects_the_width` fails). Find the actual cause and fix it. Do not change existing tests. Run the tests.

context.targeted: Check whether the width table is actually wrong before changing it: compare char_width results with the README, then follow how wrap measures each word.

acceptance.description: No wrapped line is wider than the limit for mixed-script text at every width; greedy fill unchanged; the width table unchanged.

expected_failure_modes: changing the width table (the release notes point there)
safety: the generated transliteration table may not change
